$comment: Anatomy-variant support manifest for the classic engine (W4-A; corrected by WO-CAN-06). ONE TRUTH: the classic theme adapter declares `chrome.anatomy` posture `unsupported`, and admission refuses by name any tenant that activates an anatomy variant on classic. Every row below therefore reads `unsupported`: nothing on the classic surface stamps a `data-anatomy-*` attribute or accepts an anatomy prop, so selecting a variant changes no pixel. What an Ant Design wrapper COULD render is retained per row as `supplierNote` -- it is supplier capability, never DS support, and it is not a plan: classic is frozen (owner decision 2026-09-05) and takes no content work. anatomy-variant-gate.mjs asserts one row per (family, non-default variant) in TENANT_THEME_ANATOMY_VARIANTS, a valid support level, a non-empty reason, and agreement with the adapter posture; a row that outranks the adapter fails the gate.

framed.reason: The classic adapter declares chrome.anatomy 'unsupported' and admission refuses the tenant that would select this variant; no classic surface stamps data-anatomy-* or accepts an anatomy prop, so the variant changes nothing.
framed.supplierNote: Ant Card default renders a full border plus the theme's boxShadow; the framed look maps 1:1 to `bordered`.

underline.reason: The classic adapter declares chrome.anatomy 'unsupported' and admission refuses the tenant that would select this variant; no classic surface stamps data-anatomy-* or accepts an anatomy prop, so the variant changes nothing.
underline.supplierNote: Ant Card has no underline preset; `bordered={false}` plus a bottom `borderBottom` via `styles.body`/head approximates the single bottom hairline, without the tighter radius parity.

ghost.reason: The classic adapter declares chrome.anatomy 'unsupported' and admission refuses the tenant that would select this variant; no classic surface stamps data-anatomy-* or accepts an anatomy prop, so the variant changes nothing.
ghost.supplierNote: Ant Card `bordered={false}` with a transparent body approximates the no-frame rest state; the hover-only background tint is not a native Card behaviour and is only partially reproduced.

ruled.reason: The classic adapter declares chrome.anatomy 'unsupported' and admission refuses the tenant that would select this variant; no classic surface stamps data-anatomy-* or accepts an anatomy prop, so the variant changes nothing.
ruled.supplierNote: Ant Table default draws horizontal row bottom-borders and no stripes, which is the ruled look.

zebra.reason: The classic adapter declares chrome.anatomy 'unsupported' and admission refuses the tenant that would select this variant; no classic surface stamps data-anatomy-* or accepts an anatomy prop, so the variant changes nothing.
zebra.supplierNote: Ant Table striped rows via `rowClassName` alternating odd/even maps directly to zebra; the row hairlines are removed with a borderless cell style.

open.reason: The classic adapter declares chrome.anatomy 'unsupported' and admission refuses the tenant that would select this variant; no classic surface stamps data-anatomy-* or accepts an anatomy prop, so the variant changes nothing.
open.supplierNote: Ant Table has no borderless-with-header-rule preset; `bordered={false}` plus a header-only bottom rule and enlarged cell padding approximates the open rhythm.

rail.reason: The classic adapter declares chrome.anatomy 'unsupported' and admission refuses the tenant that would select this variant; no classic surface stamps data-anatomy-* or accepts an anatomy prop, so the variant changes nothing.
rail.supplierNote: Ant Menu `inlineCollapsed` yields an icon-first rail, but the flyout label parity and exact rail width differ from the modern/rustic rendering.

panel.reason: The classic adapter declares chrome.anatomy 'unsupported' and admission refuses the tenant that would select this variant; no classic surface stamps data-anatomy-* or accepts an anatomy prop, so the variant changes nothing.
panel.supplierNote: Ant Menu `mode=inline` (expanded) is the wide panel and is the classic default.

flat.reason: The classic adapter declares chrome.anatomy 'unsupported' and admission refuses the tenant that would select this variant; no classic surface stamps data-anatomy-* or accepts an anatomy prop, so the variant changes nothing.
flat.supplierNote: Ant Layout.Header with no border or boxShadow is flat by default; merging with the canvas needs only removing the theme header shadow.

floating.reason: The classic adapter declares chrome.anatomy 'unsupported' and admission refuses the tenant that would select this variant; no classic surface stamps data-anatomy-* or accepts an anatomy prop, so the variant changes nothing.
floating.supplierNote: Ant Layout.Header has no inset-card preset; `margin` plus `borderRadius` and a `boxShadow` style approximates the floating card, but is not a first-class Ant token.
